sources.entry: polluSensWeb - Web-based serial interface and charting tool for visualizing and logging data from UART pollution sensors (PM2.5, VOC, etc). Features live data acquisition, dynamic charts, CSV export, and webhook integration. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) MIT Javascript

summary.one_liner: polluSensWeb is a browser-based tool that connects to UART air quality sensors via the Web Serial API, then parses, charts, logs, and exports their readings.
summary.what_it_does: It opens a serial connection to a UART sensor from the browser, sends configured commands, and buffers incoming bytes into frames using start/end bytes and length. Each frame's checksum is validated, and signal values are extracted from JSON-defined expressions. Parsed data is shown in multiple dynamic, customizable live charts and in a log of raw hex packets with checksum results. Collected data since connection can be exported to CSV, and readings can be sent to an HTTP endpoint through configurable webhook headers and JSON body templates. Sensor definitions come from a sensors.json file with about 39 listed sensors, and custom JSON configurations can be uploaded.
use_cases: visualize air quality sensor data in the browser
log PM2.5 and VOC readings to CSV
teaching labs and education with air sensors
rapid IoT sensor prototyping over serial
send sensor readings to an HTTP webhook
add support for a custom UART sensor via JSON
how_to_run: Open the hosted live version (linked in README) in a supported Chromium browser
Or extract the release archive or git clone and open index.html in the browser
Load sensors.js via the Custom JSON Sensor Configuration input in the UI
For self-hosting, set DEFAULT_SENSOR_LIST and PROXY_URL at the top of pollusensweb.js to your own addresses
notable: Supports dozens of UART air quality and environmental sensors (Plantower, Sensirion, SenseAir, Honeywell, Nova, and others) via JSON config
Multi-command sequences with per-command baud rate switching, useful for 1-Wire over UART
Sensor configs can inherit from other sensors and override commands
Webhooks with templated headers and JSON bodies, including per-field placeholders
caveats: Requires a Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera); Web Serial API is not supported in Firefox or Safari
Webhooks need network access; the rest works offline after load
Self-hosting requires editing the source to point at your own sensor list and CORS proxy
keywords: send sensor data to http endpoint
